items.message: The daily limit is read from an environment variable and parsed with `float()`. An attacker or misconfigured environment that sets `IN_LOCKSTEP_DAILY_LIMIT` to a very large value (e.g., `1e308` or `inf`) silently means no practical ceiling — the check `spent < limit` will always pass. The code handles non-numeric values loudly, but does not validate that the parsed float is a finite, positive, sane number.
